name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — SKELETON ONLY at v0.1.0: the sole working command is `help`, and the other fourteen in the design specification are declared-not-built, each labelled as such in commands/help.md so nobody invokes a command that does not exist and gets a guess instead. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. Binds to req through contract files (requirements.json, glossary.json) and MUST halt naming the missing path rather than infer when one is absent. Ownership is per file, never per folder: no JSON file is written by two plugins even for disjoint fields, because regeneration rewrites the whole file and the other party's data disappears silently — so the trace graph is split by author (trace.design.json) and joined at read time by ID. Every artifact carries an ID that traces up to a REQ, every command reads design.state.json before acting and updates it on completion, and completion is decided by a script's exit code, never by a model declaring itself done.
